capability_definitions.rag_required: YES only when correct answering requires course knowledge or course material not already supplied in the model-visible input.
capability_definitions.memory_required: YES only when correct answering requires student-specific information absent from visible history and retrievable only from long-term Memory.
capability_definitions.planning_required: YES when evidence must be transformed into an actionable sequence, prioritisation, schedule, or concrete next-step plan.

metric_definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of the three per-capability F1 scores on Gold ANSWER cases.
metric_definitions.micro_f1: F1 after pooling TP, FP, and FN assignments across the three capabilities on Gold ANSWER cases.
metric_definitions.example_based_f1: Mean per-case set F1; two empty sets score 1.
metric_definitions.jaccard_similarity: Mean per-case intersection over union; two empty sets score 1.
metric_definitions.exact_set_match: Fraction of Gold ANSWER cases with all three capability bits correct.
metric_definitions.hamming_loss: Incorrect capability assignments divided by ANSWER cases times three labels.
metric_definitions.under_routing_rate: Fraction of Gold ANSWER cases with at least one omitted required capability.
metric_definitions.over_routing_rate: Fraction of Gold ANSWER cases with at least one unnecessary predicted capability.
metric_definitions.under_routing_assignment_rate: False-negative capability assignments divided by all Gold-positive assignments.
metric_definitions.over_routing_assignment_rate: False-positive capability assignments divided by all Gold-negative assignments.
metric_definitions.answerability_accuracy: ANSWER versus CLARIFY accuracy over all cases, evaluated separately from capability metrics.
metric_definitions.contrast_consistency: Fraction of registered contrast pairs whose predicted changed-label set exactly matches the frozen Gold changed-label set.

data_roles.RQ2_V1_AUTHENTIC_PILOT: Qualitative realism, codebook audit, descriptive retrospective transfer only; not untouched RQ2-V2 test.
data_roles.RQ2_V1_SYNTHETIC_STRESS: Development augmentation, rare-combination stress, and code validation only; not authentic and not final test.
data_roles.RQ2_V2_HUMAN_ELICITED: Planned controlled benchmark; not created in Stage 0.
data_roles.RQ2_V2_LLM_AUGMENTED: Optional future DEV-family paraphrases only, with preserved generation provenance and human verification.
